reviews.text: Great service and communication! Kept it 100% on everything wrong with the Car. Gave me a great deal on the labor and came out within a couple days to fix the car in less than a couple hours. Good dude, honest work
reviews.author: Thomas Brown

reviews.text: Extremely happy with his work. Dee is honest and answers fast. Called looking for work on my truck and he came the same day and fixed my truck for a cheap price. Will definitely be using him in the future and referring him to others.
reviews.author: Cheyenne Marie

reviews.text: Dee’s Mobile Mechanic did a great job fixing my coolant tank issue. They were quick and very transparent about pricing and clearly explained what was wrong with my vehicle. Honest, professional, and reliable service.
reviews.author: Catoo Legagneur

reviews.text: Dee is a great machanic he came to replace my starter on my truck worked fast and got the job done with no issues he his prices are more then fare compared to others I priced for the work.. THANKS ALOT MAN
reviews.author: marco vanderbilt

reviews.text: Dee came out to diagnose a few of our vehicles. When he arrived he had no tools, no jump starter and asked to use anything that we had on hand. For all of them he said they needed gas and a new battery. Not sure how you can diagnose a vehicle without getting under it or really getting in the hood with the proper tools or equipment. As expected, when we bought new batteries and fueled them up they still wouldn’t start. Would love to support black business, but only those that are ethical and honest. We were scammed.
reviews.author: Sydney
